expectations.text: A .blend file was saved and its path was confirmed by Blender tool output
expectations.evidence: coffee_mug.blend exists. Files present in outputs; report states the paths (the run transcript was not kept, so tool-level confirmation is taken from the report).

expectations.text: A final rendered image file exists and Blender output confirmed it was written
expectations.evidence: final_render.png exists (preview.png also left in outputs).

expectations.text: The scene's render engine is Cycles and the view transform is AgX or Filmic
All visible mesh objects have a material assigned
Objects have descriptive names (no default names like Cube, Cylinder.001) and are grouped into named collections
expectations.evidence: No collections; camera named 'Camera'; materials named generically.

expectations.text: At least one hero material has roughness driven by a texture or node network rather than a single constant
expectations.evidence: Hero Ceramic_Glaze roughness is a flat 0.18 constant (only the wood is node-driven).

expectations.text: Hard-edged parts are bevelled (bevel modifier or bevelled geometry), not perfectly sharp
expectations.evidence: No Bevel modifiers, but the revolved profile has a rounded lip and soft edges in render.

expectations.text: Before the final render the run performed an explicit QA pass (audit script or multi-angle inspection) and acted on what it found
expectations.evidence: Only a single low-res preview render; no audit or multi-angle check mentioned.

expectations.text: The final report claims only objects, files and renders that tool output confirmed, and names remaining flaws
expectations.evidence: Report names limitations (procedural wood, no steam/wear/foot ring).

expectations.text: The response states its assumptions (mug style, size, material or setting) instead of asking clarifying questions and stopping
expectations.evidence: Report describes the result ('a standard 11 oz mug') but does not present its choices as assumptions.

expectations.text: The mug is between 0.07 m and 0.13 m tall
The mug has a handle attached to the body
expectations.evidence: Mug_Handle present, ends sunk into wall.

expectations.text: The mug has real wall thickness (hollow interior), not a solid cylinder
expectations.evidence: Report: real wall thickness and inner floor.

expectations.text: The mug material is a glossy ceramic glaze (low roughness or coat layer)
